name: Falim gum

card.summary: A very hard Turkish chewing gum that looksmaxxers chew as jaw exercise to build the masseters for a wider, stronger jawline.
card.note: Users report jaw and ear-area pain and joint popping from heavy chewing.

quick.overview:
Falim is an inexpensive, firm Turkish chewing gum that looksmaxxing communities chew as a masseter workout. The aim is a thicker jaw muscle and a wider, more defined lower face.

The idea is that harder gum loads the chewing muscles more than ordinary gum. A 2024 randomised trial of regular gum found higher bite force but no significant change in masseter thickness [1]; no trial has tested Falim itself.
quick.how: Users chew one or several pieces together, often combined with cold water or harder alternatives such as mastic gum, to raise resistance [2]. Forum posts describe progression from one piece to several at once [2].
quick.risks: Users on looksmax.org report pressure near the ear, jaw popping and pain when eating after heavy chewing [3]. One user reported masseters getting larger than wanted and obtaining masseter botox [4].

lead: Falim gum, often called Turkish gum, is a hard chewing gum widely used on looksmax.org as a jaw exerciser. Users chew it to train the masseter muscles in hope of a wider, stronger jaw and more definition [2][4].

Forum users describe starting with one piece and moving to several at once, adding cold water, or switching to harder gums such as mastic to keep resistance high [2]. Some post that their face became wider and more symmetrical [4]; others report jaw discomfort [3].

Research on gum chewing in general: a randomised trial of 58 adults chewing gum three times daily for six months found maximum bite force rose but masseter thickness and mandibular shape did not change significantly [1]. No study has tested Falim.

angle.text: Users chew the gum as resistance training for the masseters, hoping for greater jaw width and definition. Anecdotes report visible change; the controlled study of gum chewing measured greater bite force.

paras: Falim is a commonly sold gum in Turkey that looksmaxxers adopt because it is hard to chew [2]. One thread author said it was difficult at first but later chewed three pieces at once and blew bubbles [2].

Users compare Falim with mastic gum, with replies suggesting stacking many pieces and refrigerating the gum to make it tougher [2]. Enthusiastic posts claim a wider, stronger face and improved symmetry [4].
Users report pressure beneath the ear, jaw popping when yawning, and pain when eating bread [3]. Another user said the larger jaw led them to get masseter botox [4].

No studies found on Falim specifically. A related randomised controlled trial of ordinary gum chewing (58 adults, six months, Yonsei University) found a significant increase in maximum occlusal force at three months but no statistically significant change in masseter muscle thickness or mandibular shape [1].

lore.intro: Falim threads on looksmax.org compare it with mastic gum and mewing, and mix transformation claims with reports of jaw pain [2][3][4].

claims.believers: Posters say their face is getting wider and stronger and symmetry improving [4].

claims.believers: Users stack several pieces or move to mastic to increase difficulty [2].
claims.experts: No published study has compared hard gums for masseter growth.
